tei:div.tei:p: gung ru rgyal mtshan bzang po ni rje tsong kha pa'i dngos slob yi dam gyi lung bstan pa zhig yin la 'phrin las nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i bu chen bzhi'am lnga'i ya gyal zhig kyang yin/ dge slong ma dpal mo'i skye bar grags/ rje 'di mdo stod lho rong gung ru'i yul du rab byung drug pa'i chu phag spyi lo （ 1383） lor sku 'khrungs/ lung dang rigs pa smra ba la mtshungs pa med pas mtshungs med chos rje dang*/ mdo stod pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang*/ mdo khams stod pa dh+wa dza bha dra/ 'khar thogs pa rgyal mtshan bzang po bcas mtshan gyi rnam grangs mang*/ gzhon nu'i dus nas gsang phur phebs/ rje yab sras dang*/ byang sems rwa sgreng ba chen po sogs tshul bzhin du bsten nas dka' bzhi la mkhas pa'i grags pa thob| khyad par dbu ma la rtsal du thon/ rje tsong kha bas mkhan po dang*/ 'dul 'dzin grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis las slob/ rgyal tshab dar ma rin chen gyis gsang ston mdzad de bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes/ lho brag grub chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan las kyang chos gsan par snang*/ gsang phu bai ser du 'chad nyan gyi slob dpon mdzad/ lo chen dwags po ba dang*/ slob dpon dge legs rgyal mtshan rtsod pas pham par byas/ de nas se ra'i mkhan thog gsum par phebs| bstod pa grwa tshang btab/ 'dul 'dzin grags pa rgyal mtshan gshegs rjes btsun mo tshal dgon dang gdan sa nyis 'dzin gyi sgo nas chos gsungs/ de bzhin rtsed thang dang*/ skyor mo lung gnyis su yang 'chad nyan rtsom gsum gyi bya ba mdzad/ dge slong ma dpal mo'i thugs dam gyi rten 'phags pa thugs rje chen po 'phags ma nyid kyis nyang bran gyi brag nor bu dga' 'khyil 'dra ba'i 'og tu gter du sbas pa rje nyid kyis gter nas bton cing se ra'i 'du khang chen mo'i gzims chung 'chi med dpal ster te thugs rje lha khang gi rten gtsor bzhugs su gsol/ lho brag grub chen phyag rdor pa'i drung nas grub chen nyid dang rje tsong kha pa mjal tshul gyi skor rnams zhus/

slob ma yang gsang phu ba dpal ldan seng ge dang*/ gung ru chos rje rin chen byang chub/ kun legs pa/ pu to bla ma gzhon nu dkon mchog 'brong steng bla ma sangs rgyas tshul khrims/ dpung mkhar bla ma rgyal mchog pa/ ri kha bla ma grogs 'ong ba/ byi'u gnas brtan pa/ kong po ri kha dgon gyi bla ma grags pa 'od zer sogs gzhan don nus pa mang du byung*/ dgung lo re brgyad pa rab byung brgyad pa'i lcags rta spyi lo （ 1450） lor gshegs| gdung rten ni ser sngags grwa tshang gi 'od dpag lha khang gi gzhogs g.yas su bzhugs shing da dung rje nyid kyi phyag 'khar byin can zhig kyang se ra'i tshogs chen 'du khang chen mo'i yang thog thugs rje lha khang du bzhugs/ gsung 'bum gras la/ stong mthun rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum dang*/ dbu ma'i lta khrid/ bdag med pa'i don sgom tshul gyi rim pa/ dbu ma'i spyi don blo bzang dga' bskyed/ rtsa ba shes rab kyi 'grel ba/ rigs pa drug cu pa'i 'grel ba/ rtsod bzlog gi 'grel ba/ bzhi brgya ba'i 'grel ba/ dbu ma rgyan gyi 'grel ba/ dbu ma 'jug pa'i rnam bshad rten 'byung gi de nyid gsal byed/ shes rab snying po'i 'grel ba/ rten 'brel bstod pa'i 'grel ba/ rtogs brjod mdun legs ma'i 'grel ba/ mngon rtogs rgyan gyi 'grel ba mkhas pa'i yid 'phrog dang*/phar phyin byams pa'i dgongs rgyan/ mdo sde rgyan gyi 'grel ba/ dbus mtha' rnam 'byed kyi 'grel ba/ chos nyid rnam 'byed kyi 'grel ba/ mngon pa mdzod kyi 'grel ba/ 'dul ba'i spyi don/ tshad ma'i bstan bcos mkhas pa dga' bskyed sogs mkhas pa mgu ba bskyed pa'i bstan bcos mtha' yas pa mdzad pa sogs 'phrin las nam mkha' dang mnyam pa byung ngo*// //dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas grwa blo bzang chos 'byor gy-is bkod/rnam thar mdor bsdus/rnam thar mdor bsdus/ PAGE 2-PAGE 3-PAGE
